# Paul Thomas — Portfolio & Engineering Context

> Computer Science Engineering Student & Apprentice Researcher in AI, Embedded Systems, and Federated Learning.

## Summary

- [Portfolio](https://pthomas.fr): Main engineering portfolio and interactive showcase.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/PLRpower): Open source repositories, embedded systems, and machine learning models.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paul-thomas-strasbourg/): Professional profile, academic background, and publications.
- [Email Contact](mailto:contact@pthomas.fr): Direct contact for inquiries and research opportunities.

## Key Focus Areas

- **Distributed AI & Federated Learning**: Designing, implementing, and evaluating decentralized collaborative machine learning architectures across physical edge device clusters (Raspberry Pi 4/5, NVIDIA Jetson, Linux aggregation servers).
- **Embedded Systems & Low-Level**: Firmware engineering in C/C++, AVR ATmega328 bare-metal, ROS 2, Linux kernels, real-time sensor ingestion, non-blocking Timer ISRs, serial/MQTT/WebSocket protocols.
- **Full-Stack, Systems & Operations Research**: Scalable systems in C# (.NET 10), Python, PyTorch, C++20, TypeScript, Nuxt 3, React, Docker Swarm, and combinatorial optimization solvers (PuLP/CBC, Genetic Algorithms).

## Projects & Engineering Artifacts

- [Edge Federated Learning Platform](https://pthomas.fr/projects/federated-learning): Distributed ML testbed on a 20-node physical cluster at LINEACT Laboratory.
- [Axiom Chess](https://pthomas.fr/projects/axiom-chess): Spatial computing and AR chess ecosystem combining YOLO computer vision, hybrid Minimax ML engine, and dynamic AR board projection.
- [Mundo Browser](https://pthomas.fr/projects/mundo-browser): High-performance desktop browser built on .NET 10 and WebView2 with native split-view, in-process ad-blocking (FrozenSet), and EcoMode memory manager.
- [Delivery Route Optimization (TSP-CP)](https://pthomas.fr/projects/vehicle-route-optimization): Operations research platform solving Traveling Salesman Problems with Precedence Constraints using exact ILP (PuLP/CBC), heuristics, and Genetic Algorithms.
- [Conway's Game of Life](https://pthomas.fr/projects/conway-game-of-life): High-performance C++20 cellular automaton with OpenMP multi-threading, SFML/Console dual rendering, and SOLID architecture.
- [WorldWide Weather Watcher (3W)](https://pthomas.fr/projects/embedded-weather-station): Resilient maritime embedded weather station on Arduino UNO R3 with SysML modeling, 4 state-machine operational modes, and FAT32 fail-safe SD rotation.
- [Hydro Regen](https://pthomas.fr/projects/hydro-regen): Award-winning regenerative hydrology mapping platform (3rd Place & Jury's Favorite from Office International de l'Eau at Aquathon 2024).
- [À la carte](https://pthomas.fr/projects/a-la-carte): Modern collaborative kitchen operating system with multi-modal AI (camera OCR, Gemini suggestions, URL scraper) and Supabase PostgreSQL RLS.
- [RobotKraft — Autonomous Robotic Arm](https://pthomas.fr/projects/robotkraft): Embodied AI and imitation learning on physical SO-ARM101 arms using Hugging Face LeRobot and Docker.
- [Avenird](https://pthomas.fr/projects/avenird): Digital sovereignty and open-source education platform built in 15h for Nuit de l'Info 2025, featuring TruthBot AI Arena and anti-ergonomic UI.
- [Intern Rift — Web4All](https://pthomas.fr/projects/intern-rift): Handcrafted PHP 8+ MVC architecture without frameworks, Eloquent ORM, and Role-Based Access Control.
- [TIDES](https://pthomas.fr/projects/tides): Satirical greenwashing detector and interactive web experience built in 15h for Nuit de l'Info 2023.
- [Exolia Ecosystem Architecture](https://pthomas.fr/projects/exolia): Distributed gaming infrastructure monorepo with Spigot high-throughput HikariCP backend, Forge coremods, and Java launcher.
- [Variational Quantum Classifiers (QML)](https://pthomas.fr/projects/variational-quantum-classifiers): Hybrid quantum-classical neural networks using PennyLane, Qiskit, and PyTorch.
- [Custom Search Robot](https://pthomas.fr/projects/custom-search-robot): Autonomous mobile robot with LiDAR SLAM, Nav2 path planning, and embedded YOLO vision in GPS-denied spaces.
- [Mundo Search](https://pthomas.fr/projects/mundo-search): AI-powered search engine synthesizing queries into interactive visual concept mindmaps.
- [Web Projects Monorepo](https://pthomas.fr/projects/web-projects): Centralized monorepo of web applications, campus platforms, and financial trading APIs.
- [Computer Science & Algorithms Collection](https://pthomas.fr/projects/python-cs-courses): Curated collection of CS algorithms, Lotka-Volterra simulations, backtracking Sudoku, and Django systems.
